description:
ID card design, encoding, and printing software

CardExchange Producer makes ID card production simple yet powerful. Whether you need a quick and easy way to design cards for small teams or a robust system for managing thousands of employees, flexible editions can be tailored to fit your needs.
- New Functionality
  Introduced a new LDAP plug-in with full support for LDAPS connections
- New Functionality
  Introduced a new Paxton NET2 plug-in providing compatibility with Paxton NET2 v7.0 and its API.
- New Functionality
  Added support for TLS 1.3 connections
- New Functionality
  Added support for folder naming using emojis
- New Functionality
  Users can now export photos for multiple records simultaneously, with customisable file formats and save locations
- New Functionality
  Added support for the Evolis Zenius 2
- New Functionality
  Added support for the Dascom DC-7600
- Improvement
  Updated Magicard SDK to version 3.2.8.2
- Improvement
  Enhanced face detection and "crop-to-face" precision
- Improvement
  Improved support for Magicard NEO and Authentys 600 printers
- Improvement
  Improved support and stability for Python scripts
- Improvement
  Enhanced Magicard 600 connectivity via Ethernet when using the CardExchange® Print Server
- Bug Fix
  Fixed an issue where names from LDAP sources containing apostrophes (e.g., O’Riley) were being incorrectly escaped (O''Riley)
- Bug Fix
  Fixed photo loading issues from LDAP sources
- Bug Fix
  Resolved an issue where mappings were deleted if a card was created without a defined database
- Bug Fix
  Fixed a bug preventing the deletion of database connections within the Database Manager
- Bug Fix
  Fixed false positive font-missing warning for fonts with weight-encoded family names (e.g. Arial Black)
- Bug Fix
  Fixed a navigation bug where clicking the drop-down in the Cards tab would switch tabs instead of opening the menu
- Bug Fix
  Corrected an issue where the image editor would default to "Cancel" instead of "Confirm."
- Bug Fix
  Improved Dutch translation accuracy
- Bug Fix
  Resolved module licensing issues and "Check for Updates" failures
- Bug Fix
  Disabled deprecated calls to the e-marketing portal to prevent connection failures
- Bug Fix
  Resolved PDF147 generation failures caused by invalid ASCII characters
- Bug Fix
  Fixed an "object reference not found" error when modifying MIFARE/DESFire definitions
- Bug Fix
  Fixed an issue where typing the colour name or the hex color code would display an error
